newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: 1604 GMT - Portuguese shares closed lower as investors took profits and dealers said the trend could continue tomorrow if international bourses keep falling. The main activity is likely to be in Portugal Telecom, ship repairer Lisnave and industrial group Sonae Investimentos.
* PSI-20 index .PSI20 down 0.21 pct (10.11 points) to 4,765.11
* "The main European bourses changed trend and are now falling, which is negative for our market," said one operator.

* Dealers noted profit taking in Portugal Telecom (PT) and Cimpor, which had risen recently. The drop in Cimpor was aggravated by published remarks by its president Antonio Sousa Gomes in which he said he believed the stock was expensive. PT closed at 4,055 escudos, down 12, in volume of 248,662 shares and Cimpor closed at 3,282 escudos, down 37, in volume of 89,204 shares.
* Lisnave was a focus of speculative trade, dealers said. It closed at 369 escudos, down six, in volume of 239,391 shares.
